PS Plus is an ongoing subscription with a recurring subscription fee which is charged automatically (at the then current PS Store price) at the frequency you choose at purchase until cancelled. Full terms apply: see Terms of Service and PS Plus Usage Terms at www.playstation.com/legal.PS Plus content and services vary by subscriber age. PS Plus is only available to legal residents of the servicing territory who meet the age requirements in their country of residence. Below legal age of majority requires parental consent.
